value.answer: Honestly it's split, but I'd lean Honda Odyssey. It's the top pick in the most recent U.S. News ranking (9.3/10) and Car Talk's staff picked it, and it's one of the best to drive. If you care more about fuel economy or AWD, the Toyota Sienna is the one to look at (it's hybrid-only and gets about 36 mpg combined). The Kia Carnival is right behind both, and it's the cheapest. Those rankings are mostly U.S., so the prices and mpg are U.S. figures. I couldn't find current Canadian pricing, so if you're in Canada, check local prices before you decide.
